The annual inspection shall include, at a minimum, visual confirmation that all covered systems are in their stored locations and ready for deployment, and that any gaskets do not appear damaged or brittle.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
